redTestChanges.reason: spec.md wires postTurn's new 6th `mint` parameter to a REAL default (defaultMintChatCredential -> mintEphemeralMcpCredential); every CH-03-authored test in this file that predates CH-04 calls postTurn with only 5 args (mint omitted) and so falls through to that real default, which hits live Postgres (unavailable in a unit-test environment) and turns into ChatEnqueueError. Verified empirically: without a fix, this file goes from 7 failing (the correct red state) to 12 failing -- 5 previously-passing, minting-unrelated CH-03 cases regress. Added one module-level vi.mock('./ephemeralMcpCredentialService', ...) block (mirrors the pre-existing convention in ephemeralMcpCredentialService.test.ts, where every call already passes injected fakes rather than the live default). The six CH-04 minting cases all pass an explicit mint stub as postTurn's 6th argument, which always takes precedence over this module-level mock, so this touches zero AC-7/AC-14/EC-24/EC-25/EC-26 assertions. No assertion in any pre-existing or new test was weakened, loosened, or removed -- confirmed via full-file run before (7 failing) and after (0 failing, 55/55) this change plus the real implementation.
